items.title: How CrossDrop works
items.author: The CrossDrop plugin on your KOReader device sends the book you're reading to this reader over Wi-Fi — no cable. Requires a CrossPoint beta build with plugin support; this side needs nothing installed (File Transfer is built in).

items.title: 1 · Install the KOReader plugin
items.author: On the sending device, copy the crossdrop.koplugin folder into koreader/plugins/ and restart KOReader. Then open the gear menu → CrossDrop.

items.title: 2 · Put this reader in receive mode
items.author: Main menu → File Transfer → Join Network. The address that appears on this screen is the one you will type on the KOReader side.

items.title: 3 · Enter this address in KOReader
items.author: In CrossDrop → Device IP..., type the address shown on this reader's screen (port 80, folder /Books). Save it once and CrossDrop remembers it.

items.title: 4 · Send your current book
items.author: Gear menu → CrossDrop → Send current book. Optionally pick Destination folder... first. Watch the live progress dialog here and on the sender.

items.title: 5 · The book lands on this reader
items.author: When the send finishes, the book is on this SD card in the folder you picked and shows up in this reader's library — nothing else to do.

items.title: No router? Use the reader hotspot
items.author: Main menu → File Transfer → Create Hotspot on this reader, join that Wi-Fi from the sender, then pick CrossDrop → CrossDrop hotspot (192.168.4.1) — no address to type.

items.title: Verify the connection
items.author: CrossDrop → Check device... on the sender confirms this reader answered. If a send fails, confirm the address matches the Join Network screen.
